decisions.reason: The multi-model flail shredder line has its own page and substantial sunk development, and it fits the firm's mobile processing core, so management would persist and blame the missing 2020-2021 visibility on pandemic-related disruption.

The mobile high-speed grinder line is a multi-model investment aligned with the firm's mobile strategy, so despite low web visibility and no recent evidence management would justify keeping it as a temporary market slowdown.

As a single product with low visibility and limited sunk cost, the electric fine shredder is the most exposed, but its fit with the announced resource-saving, electric direction lets management attribute weak results to temporary causes.
The green-waste grinder line serves core composting and biomass customers and spans several models, so management remains committed even though its web presence is limited.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line has its own page and underpins the firm's push into tougher stationary processing, so strong public commitment makes a withdrawal unlikely.
